title: Oobmab
body:
Description

Oobmab is a variant of Bamboo that can be found within Uncertainty Cave. After locating the wall labeled "explosives needed" and blowing it up, Oobmab can be found a short way into the revealed passage.

Oobmab grows from a flat, pink, glowing surface thats harmless.

Trivia

  • The name "Oobmab" is "Bamboo" spelled backwards.
  • Oobmab has the inverse color of Bamboo.
